name: Doodle Bluff
description: Everyone draws a secret phrase. Then round by round: one drawing goes up, everyone invents a fake title for it, and the class votes for the real one. Points for spotting the truth, points for fooling classmates.
tagline: The draw-and-bluff party format. Students write the phrases for each other, you bring the list, or the AI writes them: silly phrases for fun, or vocabulary and concepts from your unit for sneaky review.

phraseSource.label: Who writes the phrases?
phraseSource.helper: Pick one; the line under it says what happens.

valueHelp.students: Each student writes one phrase and draws a classmate's. The writer and the drawer both sit out that drawing's round, so it wants 8 or more players.
valueHelp.teacher: You type the list below, one per line. Each student is handed one at random; only the drawer sits out, so any class size works.
valueHelp.ai: The AI writes 36 phrases about your topic right here, so you can read and change them before class. Only the drawer sits out, so any class size works. Leave the list empty and the AI writes one per student when the room opens instead.

phrasePrompt.label: What should students write as secret phrases?
phrasePrompt.helper: Only when students write the phrases. Silly phrases for fun, or terms from your unit for review.
phrasePrompt.placeholder: Write a short, strange phrase that would be fun to watch someone draw. Example: a nervous volcano on its first day of school.
phrasePrompt.default: Write a short, strange phrase that would be fun to watch someone draw. Example: a nervous volcano on its first day of school.

phrases.label: Your phrases, one per line
phrases.helper: Each student is handed one at random. Bring at least as many phrases as students, 36 covers most classes: a shorter list repeats, and anyone handed the same phrase as the drawing on screen sits that round out. Vocabulary, concepts from the unit, or anything silly.
default: A nervous volcano on its first day of school
A snowman on a beach holiday
Two clouds arguing about the weather
A sandwich with a secret identity
Ducks holding a very serious meeting
A dragon afraid of birthday candles
A penguin who lost its umbrella
An owl who forgot its glasses
A hedgehog stuck in a hammock
The last slice of pizza escaping
A snail late for the bus
A pirate at a tea party
A very polite bear at the library
A whale learning to ride a bicycle
A wizard whose hat blew away
A pumpkin lifting weights at the gym
A robot afraid of a toaster

aiTopic.label: What should the AI's phrases be about?
aiTopic.helper: A topic or a mood: "the water cycle", "Ancient Rome, but silly", "things that happen in a cafeteria". The AI writes the phrases into the list above; change any of them.
aiTopic.default: strange, funny, drawable scenes, like a nervous volcano on its first day of school

rounds.label: How many drawings get a round
rounds.helper: Each round is about two minutes: title, vote, reveal. A random sample of drawings runs; 6 to 8 keeps the energy up.

drawTimer.label: Drawing time (seconds)
drawTimer.helper: How long students get to draw their phrase.

description.$value: Draw a classmate's phrase, write fake titles, hunt for the real one. Built with the Doodle Bluff recipe.
description.$else: Draw the phrase you are handed, write fake titles, hunt for the real one. Built with the Doodle Bluff recipe.

phrases: a nervous volcano on its first day of school
a giraffe trying to hide behind a lamppost
a snowman on a beach holiday
a very small dragon guarding a very large sandwich
a robot who is afraid of the toaster
a cloud that forgot how to rain

message.$value:
DOODLE BLUFF!

First, write a secret phrase. Next, draw the phrase you get handed. Then, round by round: invent a fake title for each drawing and vote for the real one.

100 points for spotting the truth. 50 for every classmate your fake fools.
message.$else:
DOODLE BLUFF!

You each get a secret phrase. Draw it. Then, round by round: invent a fake title for each drawing and vote for the real one.

100 points for spotting the truth. 50 for every classmate your fake fools.

ai-phrases.instruction: Write short, strange, drawable phrases for a classroom drawing game, about: ${aiTopic}. Each phrase is 4 to 9 words, a concrete scene someone could sketch in ninety seconds, classroom-appropriate, and each one different from the others. Example shape: 'a nervous volcano on its first day of school'.

prompt.$value:
Draw this: {{phrases.assigned}}

No letters or numbers in your drawing!

$else.$value:
Draw this: {{ai-phrases.assigned}}

No letters or numbers in your drawing!
$else.$else:
Draw this: {{draw.assigned}}

No letters or numbers in your drawing!

check.template: Review the drawings below, then start the rounds. One bad drawing? Hide it from the moderation list. 'Try again' restarts the drawing round for everyone.

titles.prompt: What is the REAL title of this drawing? Make up a fake so convincing your classmates pick it.

gallery.message: The drawings that didn't get a round. One at a time: shout your guess, then the artist tells you the phrase.

end.message: That's Doodle Bluff! 100 for spotting the truth, 50 per classmate fooled. Run it again, the phrases only get weirder.
